correctness.rationale: For g=f^k, direct/inverse-image adjunction gives C_k=g^{-1}g and I_k=intersection with im g. Singleton counterexamples establish the exact fibre-saturation commutation criterion. In any nonpermutation the deepest transient tail supplies a split fibre whenever 2k>h, while a chain to a fixed point commutes at every smaller power. Since h<=n-1 this yields the sharp ceil(n/2) threshold. A bijection between eligible rank-k maps and two independent surjections onto complementary portions of im f proves the Stirling enumeration. The independent finite checker tests all 50,069 maps through n=6, but finite checks alone are not generalized.

value.rationale: The modal-past/future adjunction is a standard intrinsic feature of temporal logic; deciding when its two iterated composites commute is a natural relational expressivity question. The theorem proves the optimal universal exponent detecting irreversibility and provides a family of extremal nonpermutations. An exact rank-refined census further measures the distinct exceptional labelled deterministic frames. These are sharp nontrivial statements, not an arbitrary small computation or routine restatement of the adjunction.
